fields.Name: T146 - Lists Operations Section
fields.Description: Verifies that the Operations section (and/or Shared With Me) of the Lists app renders without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Lists app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Navigate to the Operations section (and/or the Shared With Me section). Confirm the section renders with its expected widgets or empty-state and no crash or error. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Lists app is open and the Operations section (or Shared With Me section) is the active view
The section renders its expected content or a clean empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
